Container.Name: story-labyrinth
Container.Overview:
Story Labyrinth — a purpose-built fork of The Story Nexus for long-form fiction writing: Codex-tracked character/place state, world-building chats, outline/timeline/map tools, RAG-backed continuity scanning, and AI-assisted drafting. Single-account, password-protected on first run. All data (SQLite DB + uploaded images) lives under the appdata path you set below — back that folder up to back up everything.
After starting the container, open the WebUI and follow the one-time "Create Your Account" screen. AI features need a provider configured afterward in Settings -> Providers & keys (OpenAI/OpenRouter/Grok/Gemini/local endpoint, or the built-in local in-process embedding model for RAG — no external key needed for that one).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the app listens on inside the container and is published on the host. Change the host-side value if 3000 is already taken on your Unraid box.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Everything the app owns lives here: the SQLite database, uploaded lorebook/map images, and the local embedding model cache. Back this folder up to back up the whole app. Must be owned by the same uid:gid the container runs as (see ExtraParams above) -- Unraid's own appdata default (99:100) already matches.
